decisions.statement: A landing path anywhere in the repository is taken.
A landing path holding no body is refused rather than written.
That refusal names the change making a file that is not there yet.
One export is carried by one call.
What the carrying leaves is worked out by the module this change names.
A refusal that module answers is the refusal this change answers.
Each passage the carrying leaves is written by the change this change reaches.
Nothing here writes a body of its own.
Nothing here works out which passages the carrying leaves.

definition: one export moved from one code body to another, with every importer repointed
